captureContext.important_statement: Supplier and Buyer demo images simulate inspection events. They are not claimed to be photographs of the same physical nut before and after shipment.
captureContext.purpose: Reproduce Supplier outgoing-inspection and Buyer incoming-inspection transaction scenarios using public industrial anomaly-detection images.

captureQualityPolicy.failureMeaning: A violation of a required digital-input check makes the inspection evidence nonconforming; it is not itself a product defect judgment.

modelPreprocessingBoundary.note: Resize 320 -> center crop 280 and ImageNet normalization belong to the committed model bundle, not to the physical/source capture profile.

scopeBoundary.productionMigrationRule: A real factory camera/lighting/fixture deployment requires a new validated capture profile and a new captureProfileHash.
